section: Perspectives in Education · Ch — Teacher Empowerment
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: The district-level institution primarily responsible for pre-service and in-service training of elementary school teachers, academic support to schools, and educational research at the district level is the:

options.option_text: District Institute of Education and Training (DIET)
National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)

explanation: DIETs operate at the district level to train and support elementary teachers, distinct from NCERT (national-level curriculum and research body) and UGC (regulates higher education).
